description: This file defines the code-behind for the UserProfile web page, managing user profile data retrieval from a SQL database and navigation between pages based on user session status.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Code-behind class for the UserProfile.aspx web page, handling page load and user interaction events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; retrieves and displays user data if logged in, otherwise redirects to login page.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Intended to handle navigation to the UserProfile page, but currently commented out.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs the user out by redirecting to the LoginPage.

methods.name: coursesB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the TakenCourses page.
